svg.text: 本地文献库 / 02 图神经网络
Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry
示例文献排版 · 此处为 PDF 原文视图
Message passing provides a common framework for learning
representations of molecular graphs. In this reading example,
we examine the relation between model assumptions and
experimental evidence, then identify what still needs validation.
